biocs.name: Uncommon Startup Process Execution
biocs.description: Detection of a process starting from a non-standard location during early boot phase
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' and action_process_image_name contains 'temp' and action_process_image_name contains '.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe'

abiocs.name: Early Startup Execution Anomaly
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation from typical startup process execution patterns
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' and action_process_image_name contains 'temp' and action_process_image_name contains '.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\svchost.exe'

xql_queries.name: Detect Uncommon Startup Processes
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'svchost.exe' and action_process_image_name contains 'temp' and action_process_image_name contains '.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name != 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by action_process_image_name
| comp count() as cnt by > 1
